note: Lean has no separate identity (13.3); partial summation is carried by the induction, for non-increasing g, in the form with F.

snippet.text:
have key : ∀ k, a ≤ k → k ≤ b →
      ∑ n ∈ Icc a k, f n * g n ≤ g a * F a + ∑ n ∈ Ioc a k, g n * (F n - F (n - 1)) -
        g k * (F k - ∑ m ∈ Icc a k, f m) := by
    intro k hak hkb
    induction k, hak using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp; linarith [mul_comm (f a) (g a)]
    | succ k hak ih =>
      have ih := ih (by omega)
      rw [sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), sum_Ioc_succ_top hak,
        Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      have hgk := hg k hak (by omega)
      have hSk := hS k hak (by omega)
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgk (sub_nonneg.2 hSk)]

proof_context.conclusion: Induction `key` proves the partial-summation inequality Σ_{a≤n≤k} f g ≤ g(a)F(a)+Σ g(n)(F(n)-F(n-1)) − g(k)(F(k)−S(k)), i.e. Abel summation with S(n)=Σ_{m∈Icc a n} f m.
